phase: prepared conditional development control; not a confirmatory study
execution_gate: Run only if P0/P1/P2 leave the context-association and optimization explanations unresolved
primary_learning: 15360-step heldout QA paired with the same world/initialization/organization in the original unrestricted-context runs
secondary_learning: all original checkpoints, ordinary/exception QA, base facts and autonomous two-step inference
primary_edit: none; this conditional control performs no editing
intervention: Block cross-fact attention in 60-token training documents only; retain within-fact causality
exact_controls: document tokens, fact ordering, batches and slot rotation
absolute token positions 0 through 59 without resets
twenty supervised document positions and original answer/EOS labels
0.8 document CE plus 0.2 QA CE, backward order and gradient clipping
initial model parameters, optimizer, warmup and step budget
QA identities, sampling schedule, full causal QA training attention
full causal evaluation and inference attention
aggregation: pair within world and initialization before averaging; two reused worlds are development evidence
limitations: Removing attention edges changes the training computation and may change optimization difficulty
Equal tensors, positions and supervision do not imply equal learned knowledge levels
Document slot position differences and minibatch gradient correlations remain possible mechanisms
An explicit attention mask may select a different attention kernel; assess numerical controls separately
No experiment is launched merely by creating this configuration
